paṭapaṭāyati:
[Paṭapaṭa+āya+ti]  CL=9 'Repeatedly and frequently it cooks and cooks... makes paṭapaṭā sound and crackles.'
The text explains:
1. From Moggallāna grammar (1.5): The word 'paṭapaṭākaroti' is explained as a repetitive term (dvibacana).
2. From indistinct sound imitation (avyattānukaraṇa), when combined with 'karāsa,' the rā-suffix is applied according to the rule 'dissantaññeva paccayā.'
3. Alternatively, for indistinct sound imitation, there is obligatory lengthening according to the rule 'byañjana dīgharassa.'
4. 'Paṭapaṭāyati' means 'becomes paṭapaṭā' - this formation comes from doubling in frequency, then adding āya suffix, followed by present tense endings.
5. From Pañcikā (1.5) and Kāsikā (8.1.12): It should be said that there is doubling, and 'paṭapaṭākaroti paṭapaṭāyate' shows the doubling of indistinct sound imitation ending in ḍā.
The final line states: 'It makes a crackling/popping sound (paṭ paṭ).'
[Note: This is a highly technical grammatical explanation dealing with the formation of onomatopoeic terms in Pali grammar.]

yasabhogasamappita: [Yasabhoga+samappita] (ti) CL=7 Complete with attendants and wealth.
yasakulaputta: [Yasa+kulaputta] (pu) CL=7  The meaning of the subject  see - Yasa 4-6.] A man Yasa (Yasa young man.)
yasavatīdevippamukha: [Yasavatī+devī+pamukha] (ti) CL=7 Queen Yasavatī, one who is a chief.
yathicchitaṭṭhāna: [Yathicchita+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The place/departed that should be desired, Any place you want.
yathākāmāvacara: [Yathākāma+avacara] (pu) CL=7 It is wandering according to his(one"s) desire.
yathāparādhasāsana: [Yathāparādha+(sāsa+ya)sāsana] (na) CL=7 Sāsanā(dispensation) which is disciplined by the state of sin, Vinaññaḥ Piṭaka. (Vinaññaḥ means discipline or code of conduct (for Buddhist monks)). (Piṭaka means The three respositories of Buddhist Scriptures.) . See also -  yathānuloma, yathādhammasāsana.
yathāṭhapita: [Yathā+ṭhapita] (ti) CL=7 (1) As you put. (2) where to put.
yatijana: [Yati+jana] (pu) CL=7 All of Bhikkhus, novices and lay persons.
yācatha: [Yāca+a+tha] (kri) CL=7 (You) urge them with respect. See - Yācati-(2-A). Yācatha(kri) [yāca+a+tha] Will ask.
yācissāma: [Yāca+ssāma] (kri) CL=7 (1) (A) Will ask for  something (with oral). (B) Will ask for something (with expression /Body language). See them - Yācati-(1-A, B). See original.
yācāhi: [Yāca+a+hi] (kri) CL=7 (1) (You) ask for something. See - Yācati-(1-A). (2) (A) You request and ask respectfully. See -Yācati-(2-A). (B) You request and urge respectfully. See - Yācati-(2-A).
yāmakāla: [Yāma+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of time called Yāma. (Yāma means watch(division of night).
yāpayitabbabhūta: [Yāpayitabba+bhūta] (na) CL=7 Mahābhuta which is to be balance. (Mahābhuta means the four basic properties of matter i.e solidity, fluidity, heat and volatility (commonly described as the four elements of earth, water, fire and air).
yāpyaroga: [Yāpya+roga] (pu) CL=7 (1) Illess not bad,Illness not bad enough to confine one to bed, Be fair (or) Be balance (or) Be suitable, Sore which is suffering on the body at all times. See - Yāpyarogī.
yāvakatavātāvatakavā: Yāvakataṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā(bya) [yāvakataṃ+vā+tāvatakaṃ+vā. Yaṃvātaṃ vā, yaṃkiñci- as these words , it has special appearance as per gender.] It has not exactly amount/extent .
yodhapattipākāra: [Yodhapatti+pākāra] (pu) CL=7 The wall which is infantry/infantryman.
yogavippayutta: [Yoga+vippayutta] (ti) CL=7 It is incomparable with the four kinds of Yogas. (Yoga mean shoulder yoke :lust yoke, life yoke, doctrine yoke and Ignorance yoke)
yuttagoṇa: [Yutta+goṇa] (pu) CL=7 An oxes should be put on the yoke of (cart etc.,)
yuttappamāṇajānana: [Yuttapamāṇa+jānana] (na) CL=7 Knowing about it is proper and it is not sin, Knowing about it"s extent.
yūsagata: [Yūsa+gata] (ti) CL=7 Which is inclusived in many kinds of liquid, It is reached to the state of liquid.
